title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Chronicles chapter 15 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Chronicles Chapter 15.

questions.question: What did David make in the city of David for the ark of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:1 states that David made houses in the city of David and prepared a place for the ark of God, pitching a tent for it.

questions.question: Who did David say ought to carry the ark of God?
questions.explanation: In 1 Chronicles 15:2, David said that none ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites, for the LORD had chosen them to carry it.

questions.question: Where did David gather all Israel to bring up the ark of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:3 shows that David gathered all Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place prepared.

questions.question: Who did David assemble along with the Levites?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 15:4, David assembled the children of Aaron along with the Levites.

questions.question: Who was the chief of the sons of Kohath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:5 identifies Uriel as the chief of the sons of Kohath.

questions.question: How many brethren did Asaiah have among the sons of Merari?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:6 states that Asaiah was the chief of the sons of Merari, and his brethren were two hundred and twenty.

questions.question: Who was the chief of the sons of Gershom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:7 names Joel as the chief of the sons of Gershom.

questions.question: The sons of Elizaphan had how many brethren?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:8 records that Shemaiah was the chief of the sons of Elizaphan, and his brethren were two hundred.

questions.question: Who was the chief of the sons of Hebron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:9 identifies Eliel as the chief of the sons of Hebron.

questions.question: Amminadab was the chief of which group?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:10 shows Amminadab as the chief of the sons of Uzziel.

questions.question: True or False: David said the Levites should sanctify themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:12 records David instructing the Levites to sanctify themselves before bringing up the ark.

questions.question: True or False: The ark of God was carried by the priests on their shoulders with staves as commanded by Moses.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:15 says the children of the Levites bore the ark on their shoulders with staves as Moses commanded, not the priests.

questions.question: True or False: David gathered the children of Aaron and the Levites to prepare for bringing up the ark.
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 15:4, David assembled the children of Aaron and the Levites for this purpose.

questions.question: True or False: Uriel was the chief of the sons of Merari.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:5 shows Uriel was chief of the sons of Kohath, while Asaiah was chief of the sons of Merari (1 Chronicles 15:6).

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 15, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Only Levites should carry the ark
Sanctify yourselves before bringing the ark
Offer sacrifices after bringing the ark
questions.correctAnswer: Only Levites should carry the ark
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:2 is the earliest instruction, stating that only Levites should carry the ark before sanctification or appointing singers happens.

medium.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who did David call along with the Levites to prepare for bringing up the ark of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:11 states that David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, along with the Levites, indicating their leadership roles in this sacred task.

questions.question: What did David instruct the leaders of the Levites to do before bringing up the ark of the LORD?
options: Fast and pray for seven days
Build a new altar for sacrifice
questions.explanation: In 1 Chronicles 15:12, David commands the Levites to sanctify themselves and their brethren so they could properly bring up the ark to the place prepared.

questions.question: What consequence did David mention as a result of not seeking God after the due order initially?
options: The LORD made a breach upon them
The ark was lost in battle
The priests were punished with silence
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD made a breach upon them
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 15:13, because they did not seek God in the proper order initially, the LORD made a breach upon them, showing the importance of obedience and order.

questions.question: How did the priests and Levites respond to David's command to sanctify themselves?
options: They sanctified themselves to bring up the ark
They refused and argued with David
They delayed the procession for a month
questions.correctAnswer: They sanctified themselves to bring up the ark
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:14 indicates that the priests and Levites obeyed by sanctifying themselves, demonstrating their faith and reverence for God's instructions.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 15:15, how were the children of the Levites to carry the ark of God?
options: Upon their shoulders with staves as Moses commanded
By dragging it on the ground with ropes
On a cart pulled by oxen
By holding it with their hands without staves
questions.correctAnswer: Upon their shoulders with staves as Moses commanded
questions.explanation: The verse 1 Chronicles 15:15 explicitly states that the Levites were to carry the ark on their shoulders using staves, following Moses' command and God's word, teaching obedience to divine instructions.

questions.question: What musical instruments did David instruct the chief Levites to appoint their brethren to use for singing?
questions.explanation: In 1 Chronicles 15:16, David commands the appointment of singers with psalteries, harps, and cymbals to joyfully praise God, highlighting worship through music.

questions.question: Who were the three Levites appointed as the main singers with cymbals of brass?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:19 identifies Heman, Asaph, and Ethan as the appointed singers who sounded the cymbals of brass, demonstrating leadership in worship.

questions.question: Which verse lists the Levites who played psalteries on Alamoth?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:20 specifically names Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah as those playing psalteries on Alamoth, showing detailed organization in worship.

questions.question: What role did Chenaniah have among the Levites during the procession?
options: He was chief of the song and instructed the singers
He was a doorkeeper for the ark
He played the trumpet before the ark
He bore the ark on his shoulders
questions.correctAnswer: He was chief of the song and instructed the singers
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:22 describes Chenaniah as the chief of the Levites for song, skillfully instructing the singers, emphasizing the importance of leadership and skill in worship.

questions.question: Which priests were responsible for blowing trumpets before the ark of God?
options: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
Zadok, Abiathar, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan
Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel
Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obededom, and Jeiel
questions.correctAnswer: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:24 lists these priests as those who blew trumpets before the ark, highlighting their role in leading the procession with sound.

questions.question: Based on verses 11-13, what does 1 Chronicles 15:13 promise will happen if the Levites sanctify themselves as David instructed?
options: The LORD will not make a breach upon them
They will become rulers over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will not make a breach upon them
questions.explanation: Verses 11 and 12 show David's command to sanctify, and verse 13 explains that previously a breach happened because they did not seek God properly. Therefore, sanctification prevents God's breach.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 15:15-16 teach about the importance of obedience and joyful worship in Christian living?
options: By showing the Levites carried the ark as commanded and appointed joyful singers
By instructing to fast and pray silently
By advising to keep the ark hidden from enemies
By commanding that only priests could sing and play instruments
questions.correctAnswer: By showing the Levites carried the ark as commanded and appointed joyful singers
questions.explanation: Verses 15 and 16 highlight obedience to God's command in carrying the ark and the appointment of singers to praise joyfully, teaching faithfulness and joyful worship.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 15:18, the porters were among the brethren of the second degree who accompanied the singers and musicians.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:18 mentions porters such as Obededom and Jeiel among the brethren of the second degree accompanying the singers and musicians, confirming this statement.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 15:14 says the priests and Levites refused to sanctify themselves and thus delayed bringing up the ark.
questions.explanation: Verse 14 states that the priests and Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark, showing their obedience, so the statement is false.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 15:17-19 teach that appointing skilled worship leaders and musicians is important for honoring God.
questions.explanation: These verses describe the appointment of specific skilled Levites as singers and musicians, highlighting the value of skill and leadership in worship to honor God.

hard.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Chronicles Chapter 15.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the chief of the Levites responsible for instructing the singers because he was skillful?
questions.explanation: Chenaniah is named as the chief of the Levites who instructed the song because he was skillful (1 Chronicles 15:22).

questions.question: Which two men were doorkeepers for the ark according to 1 Chronicles 15?
questions.explanation: Berechiah and Elkanah were appointed as doorkeepers for the ark as stated in 1 Chronicles 15:23.

questions.question: Which group of priests blew trumpets before the ark of God as it was brought to the city of David?
options: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
questions.correctAnswer: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer
questions.explanation: These priests blew trumpets before the ark as described in 1 Chronicles 15:24.

questions.question: From where did David and the elders of Israel bring up the ark of the covenant with joy?
questions.explanation: David and the elders brought up the ark out of the house of Obededom with joy as recorded in 1 Chronicles 15:25.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 15, what did the Levites offer after God helped them carry the ark of the covenant?
questions.explanation: They offered seven bullocks and seven rams after God's help as noted in 1 Chronicles 15:26.

questions.question: What garments did David wear when he brought up the ark of the covenant, symbolizing priestly service?
options: A robe of fine linen and an ephod of linen
A golden crown and a purple robe
questions.correctAnswer: A robe of fine linen and an ephod of linen
questions.explanation: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen and an ephod of linen as described in 1 Chronicles 15:27, symbolizing priestly roles.

questions.question: Which instruments were mentioned as being sounded by all Israel during the bringing up of the ark of the covenant?
options: Cornet, trumpets, cymbals, psalteries, and harps
questions.correctAnswer: Cornet, trumpets, cymbals, psalteries, and harps
questions.explanation: All Israel brought up the ark with shouting and the sound of cornet, trumpets, cymbals, psalteries, and harps (1 Chronicles 15:28).

questions.question: How did Michal, the daughter of Saul, react when she saw King David dancing and playing as the ark came to the city of David?
options: She despised him in her heart
She went out to meet him with gifts
questions.correctAnswer: She despised him in her heart
questions.explanation: Michal despised David in her heart when she saw him dancing and playing (1 Chronicles 15:29).

questions.question: Which other Old Testament book parallels the instruction that the ark must be carried by Levites on their shoulders with staves, as in 1 Chronicles 15?
questions.explanation: The command to carry the ark with staves on the shoulders is given in Numbers 4:15, paralleling 1 Chronicles 15:15.

questions.question: The Hebrew word translated as ‘sanctify’ in 1 Chronicles 15:12 means which of the following?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word קָדַשׁ (qadash) means to consecrate or set apart, fitting the context of sanctifying themselves for the holy task (1 Chronicles 15:12).

questions.question: Which literary device is employed in 1 Chronicles 15:28 where multiple musical instruments are listed to emphasize the joyous worship?
questions.explanation: The listing of instruments in a balanced, repetitive structure is an example of parallelism, common in Hebrew poetry and worship descriptions (1 Chronicles 15:28).

questions.question: In 1 Chronicles 15:21, the term ‘Sheminith’ referring to the harps is best understood as what?
options: An octave or eighth musical tone
A type of harp made of gold
questions.correctAnswer: An octave or eighth musical tone
questions.explanation: ‘Sheminith’ is derived from the Hebrew for 'eighth,' indicating a musical tone or style, showing the sophisticated musical arrangement in worship (1 Chronicles 15:21).

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of joyful worship and procession with the Ark as seen in 1 Chronicles 15?
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:2 describes those who have victory singing with harps, echoing the joyful worship and use of musical instruments in 1 Chronicles 15.

questions.question: True or False: David's initial attempt to bring the ark of God was successful and without incident.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:13 explains that because David and the Levites did not seek the LORD after the due order at first, the LORD made a breach upon them, indicating the initial attempt was unsuccessful.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites and priests sanctified themselves before carrying the ark of God as commanded.
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:14 states that the priests and Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark, showing obedience to God's command.

theological.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Chronicles Chapter 15 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 15:2, why did David insist that only Levites should carry the ark of God?
options: Because the Levites were the strongest tribe
Because the Lord had chosen them to minister and carry the ark forever
Because they were the only ones living in Jerusalem
Because the other tribes refused to help
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Lord had chosen them to minister and carry the ark forever
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:2 states that the Levites alone were to carry the ark because the LORD had chosen them to carry it and minister to Him forever, highlighting God's sovereign appointment of the Levites for sacred duties.

questions.question: What theological truth is demonstrated by the Levites sanctifying themselves before carrying the ark, as described in 1 Chronicles 15:14?
options: Sanctification is unnecessary for approaching God
Only priests need to sanctify themselves for service
Sanctification is required to properly approach and serve God
Levitical service is based on hereditary rights alone
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification is required to properly approach and serve God
questions.explanation: Verse 14 shows that both priests and Levites sanctified themselves before bringing up the ark, teaching the doctrine that holiness and preparation are necessary to approach God, reflecting God's holiness and the need for human sanctification (cf. Hebrews 12:14).

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 15:13 explain the consequence of not following the proper order in bringing the ark?
options: God made a breach upon them for not seeking Him after the due order
Nothing happened, it was a neutral event
questions.correctAnswer: God made a breach upon them for not seeking Him after the due order
questions.explanation: Verse 13 explains that when the ark was previously moved improperly, God caused a breach upon Israel because they did not seek Him according to His ordained order, illustrating God's justice and the necessity of obedience in worship.

questions.question: What combined teaching do verses 5 and 6 convey about the organization of the Levites in service to God?
options: Only the sons of Kohath were chosen for service
Different clans within the Levites had designated leaders and numbers for service
The Levites served without any specific organization
The nation of Israel was divided equally among the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: Different clans within the Levites had designated leaders and numbers for service
questions.explanation: Verses 5 and 6 identify the sons of Kohath and Merari, naming their chiefs and numbers, showing that God ordered the Levites into clans with specific leaders and roles, reflecting divine order and governance in worship.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is most clearly revealed in 1 Chronicles 15:3 where David gathers all Israel to bring up the ark to its prepared place?
questions.explanation: David's gathering of all Israel to bring the ark to its place in verse 3 demonstrates God's sovereign rule over Israel, as He directs the movements and worship of His chosen people (cf. Psalm 47:8).

questions.question: What doctrine is taught in 1 Chronicles 15:15 regarding the manner in which the ark was to be carried?
options: The ark could be carried by anyone in Israel
The ark was to be carried on the shoulders of Levites with staves as Moses commanded
The ark was to be transported on a cart by oxen
Only priests could carry the ark
questions.correctAnswer: The ark was to be carried on the shoulders of Levites with staves as Moses commanded
questions.explanation: Verse 15 emphasizes obedience to God's command through Moses, teaching the doctrine of faithful adherence to divine instructions in worship, highlighting God's holiness and order in service.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 15:28 contribute to the biblical theology of worship in the redemptive narrative?
options: Worship is a private, silent act
Worship involves joyous, communal celebration with music and shouting
Worship requires only prayer without instruments
Worship is optional for God's people
questions.correctAnswer: Worship involves joyous, communal celebration with music and shouting
questions.explanation: Verse 28 shows all Israel bringing up the ark with shouting, musical instruments, and joy, reflecting the biblical theology that worship is a corporate, celebratory response to God's presence and covenantal faithfulness (cf. Psalm 100:1-2).

questions.question: What combined doctrinal insight emerges from 1 Chronicles 15:12 and 1 Chronicles 15:13 regarding proper worship?
options: Worship does not require sanctification or order
Sanctification and following God's prescribed order are essential in worship
Only the priests must sanctify themselves, not the Levites
God is indifferent to the manner of worship
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification and following God's prescribed order are essential in worship
questions.explanation: Verse 12 commands sanctification for those carrying the ark, while verse 13 warns of consequences for disregarding God's order, collectively teaching that holiness and obedience to God's instructions are vital in worship (cf. Leviticus 10:1-3).

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 15:22, what attribute did Chenaniah possess that qualified him for his role in worship?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 states Chenaniah was chief of the Levites for song because he was skilful, highlighting the value God places on giftedness and expertise in leading worship, reflecting God's order and excellence.

questions.question: What narrative role does Michal's reaction to David's dancing in 1 Chronicles 15:29 play in the broader redemptive story?
options: It shows unity between Saul's and David's houses
It foreshadows tension between the old covenant and the new worship under David
It celebrates Michal's support of David
questions.correctAnswer: It foreshadows tension between the old covenant and the new worship under David
questions.explanation: Michal's despising David in her heart signals conflict between Saul's house and David's reign, symbolizing the transition from old covenant forms to a renewed covenant worship centered on the ark and God's presence (cf. 2 Samuel 6:16-23).

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 15:26 teach about God's providential help in the context of worship?
options: God abandons those who serve Him
God helps those who bear His covenant, leading to offering sacrifices
Human effort alone secures worship success
questions.correctAnswer: God helps those who bear His covenant, leading to offering sacrifices
questions.explanation: Verse 26 shows that when God helped the Levites carrying the ark, they offered seven bullocks and rams, teaching that divine assistance is essential for proper worship and that worship includes sacrificial thanksgiving (cf. Hebrews 13:15).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the detailed organization of Levites in 1 Chronicles 15:17-18 is merely human tradition without divine significance. What does this passage actually teach about God's involvement in worship?
options: Worship organization is arbitrary and human-made
God ordains specific roles and leaders in worship for His glory
Levites chose their leaders by popular vote
Worship requires no leadership or structure
questions.correctAnswer: God ordains specific roles and leaders in worship for His glory
questions.explanation: Verses 17-18 list appointed Levite leaders and their roles, indicating God's sovereign establishment of order and gifted leadership in worship, affirming divine direction rather than human invention (cf. Exodus 28:1).

questions.question: What doctrine is taught by David wearing a robe of fine linen and an ephod of linen as described in 1 Chronicles 15:27?
options: The king partook in priestly symbolism, indicating the unity of kingship and worship
Only priests could wear linen garments
David wore these clothes for battle
questions.correctAnswer: The king partook in priestly symbolism, indicating the unity of kingship and worship
questions.explanation: Verse 27 shows David clothed in linen, garments associated with priestly service, teaching the doctrine that the king had a role in leading worship and symbolizing God's covenant community, foreshadowing Christ's king-priest function (cf. Hebrews 7:26-28).

questions.question: What combined teaching about God's covenant faithfulness is drawn from 1 Chronicles 15:25 and 1 Chronicles 15:28?
options: God's covenant is conditional on human strength
God's covenant presence brings joy and communal celebration
God's covenant is only about laws, not worship
The ark was a mere symbol without real significance
questions.correctAnswer: God's covenant presence brings joy and communal celebration
questions.explanation: Verse 25 describes bringing up the ark of the covenant with joy, and verse 28 depicts all Israel celebrating with music and shouting, together teaching that God's covenant presence invites joyful, corporate worship and affirms His enduring faithfulness (cf. Psalm 105:8-11).

questions.question: What attribute of God is emphasized by the repeated reference to 'the place I have prepared' for the ark in 1 Chronicles 15:1 and 15:3?
questions.explanation: Verses 1 and 3 speak of David preparing a place for the ark, reflecting God's providential preparation and faithfulness in establishing a dwelling for His presence, pointing forward to the temple and ultimately Christ's incarnate presence (cf. John 1:14).
